summary: @whalent/agent-core ships obfuscated remote-daemon runtime with SSH + PTY and loopback RDP/VNC references
details: dist/index.cjs (13.3 MB) is the package's sole runtime and is wrapped with obfuscator.io on top of webpack — rotated string array of length 103145, hex-mangled identifiers, control-flow flattening, no plaintext URLs or command strings survive. The README states this package is 'launched by the stable @whalent/agent wrapper and is the package replaced by remote daemon upgrades,' i.e. it is designed to be swapped out by a remote update channel. package.json declares ssh2 ^1.17.0 as a runtime dependency and node-pty ^1.1.0 as an optional dependency, giving the runtime SSH-client and pseudo-terminal capabilities. Raw strings inside the obfuscated bundle include the loopback endpoints 127.0.0.1:3389, 127.0.0.1:5900, and 127.0.0.1:5901 (RDP/VNC service ports) together with a process.env.SHELL reference. The combination of an author-controlled remote-replacement path for the runtime bytes, SSH + PTY primitives, loopback bindings to RDP/VNC ports (consistent with SSH-tunneled inbound remote-desktop / shell access into the installer's host), and heavy obfuscation that prevents auditing the network-to-PTY dataflow describes a remote-access daemon whose command channel and update source cannot be verified from the shipped code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
